# Ali Alperen Derici

> Freelance Flutter developer building cross-platform iOS, Android, and web applications. Computer Engineering graduate, based in Turkey, working remotely with clients worldwide since 2020.

Ali Alperen Derici specializes in Flutter/Dart app development: MVPs built from Figma designs, production-grade cross-platform apps, and Flutter web development. He works with Riverpod, Firebase, and Supabase, and takes on freelance and contract work directly or via Upwork.

## Live Products & Apps
- [Analog Buddy](https://analogbuddy.com/): companion app for film photographers — light metering, frame tracking, film simulation, negative scanning, and GPS shot logging.
- [Rembetika](https://rembetikaapp.com/): professional tuner for traditional Rebetiko instruments with real-time pitch detection and customizable A4 reference.
- [Caproll](https://caproll.app/): private QR-based photo-sharing platform for weddings and events, available on iOS, Android, and Web.
- [WellNow](https://wellnowapp.com/): discover and book gyms, yoga, pilates, and spas with one tap. Built as part of [Geo Spor](https://geosportsgroup.com), alongside Fabrika Mensa (industrial tenant management) and Party Wizard (event planning).

## Experience
- 2026–present: Opex Quality, Voyage, Maxx Royal, Akra — hotel operation management mobile and web apps with CRM (Flutter, GetX, MS SQL).
- 2025–present: Train One — fitness and wellness platform with workout tracking and nutrition planning (Flutter, Riverpod, Hooks, Supabase, Domain-Driven Design).
- 2025: Upwork freelance — multiple app MVPs including social networking, news & politics, and lifestyle apps.
- 2023–2025: Akıllı Konum Teknolojileri — Kanguru (child-tracking app for parents) and Akıllı Ekip (web platform for admins and managers).
- 2020–2023: Early career roles including Mobilist (Jr. Flutter Developer), Boly, Hygge, BİKO Mühendislik, and an MVP internship at Appy Ventures.
- Full history with dates, live links, and tech stacks: https://alialperenderici.dev/#experience

## Tech Stack
- Languages & frameworks: Flutter, Dart, React, TypeScript
- State management: Riverpod, Riverpod Hooks, GetX, MobX, BLoC
- Backend & data: Firebase, Supabase, RESTful APIs, MS SQL
- Practices: Domain-Driven Design, Repository Pattern, Figma-to-code delivery, localization (English & Turkish)
